testcase_source.revision_binding: The published PR head SHA is the immutable testcase revision. The handoff records the full SHA. Both independent decisions must name that same SHA.

target.compatible_class: MBP-hosted Chrome with one physical Pixel 6 Pro on the owner's private browser bridge; USB preferred, wireless backup
target.claim_owner: x99-codex-sol selects the dedicated Android-squad executor and records the claim
target.stream_serial_source: GET /api/stream/device-state reports the first connected ADB serial; stream observations must match the exact serial in Sol's claim or be NOT-RUN. Do not reorder ADB.

synthetic_setup.preview_url_and_fixture_parent: NOT-SUPPLIED; preview owner supplies an existing isolated preview
synthetic_setup.limits: The preview has no devices and disables device, provider, lifecycle, and real task-execution routes. It is not private-phone, live-event, or provider-delivery evidence.

new_acceptance_cases.stream_observation_serial: Must equal the exact device_serial in Sol's exclusive claim; a different first-connected ADB serial makes the observation NOT-RUN.
new_acceptance_cases.safe_pre_enqueue_control: Read-only QA-B selector denial for the exact private claim serial; stop before /api/run. This proves UI-level prevention only and does not prove server-side target authorization.
new_acceptance_cases.target_control_contract: UNKNOWN and NOT-RUN; the pinned host_id branch bypasses require_device. Do not send a host-bound request until Sol verifies the serving revision and approves a reviewed control that proves rejection before enqueue and before any device command.

new_acceptance_cases.subscription_handshake: Before submission, both GET /api/stream/active SSE connections must return HTTP 200, remain open, and deliver info: Subscribed to session active.
new_acceptance_cases.capture: Submit the sole QA-A image run after both handshakes; require QA-A session_started and session_ended for its exact run. Keep QA-B capture through QA-A session_ended or 900 seconds after submission, whichever comes first. Disconnect, missing positive owner evidence, or missing owner terminal event means NOT-RUN.

new_acceptance_cases.run_count: One QA-A image run; it is also the BUG-002 event run. Do not add a provider run for event capture.

execution_gates.two_regular_qa_identities: Revalidate the two existing authorized QA profiles at the serving revision with read-only GET /api/system/whoami; no provisioning or credential action.
execution_gates.app_serving_revision_and_target_control_: MISSING; source revision is not serving acceptance, and host-bound /api/run bypasses require_device at the pinned source

negative_controls.expected_result: QA-B cannot see or select the exact private serial in the workspace phone selector; stop before any /api/run request, enqueue, or device command
negative_controls.limitation: This is UI-level only; server-side target-control remains UNKNOWN and NOT-RUN. Do not use a host-bound request or substitute the private bridge serial for Sol's reviewed host-selected serial.

negative_controls.expected_result: Reuse existing source regressions; reject before enqueue or provider activity

assertion_mutation.scope: Temporary control copy only; do not edit the reviewed journey.
assertion_mutation.original: The returned assistant answer is exactly 11/07/2016.
assertion_mutation.mutated: The returned assistant answer is exactly 11/07/2017.

negative_controls.goal: Open the same QA-A SmartQA conversation, attach the pinned screenshot.jpg, ask "What date does the yellow instruction ask me to select? Reply with only the date.", and assert that the returned assistant answer is exactly 11/07/2017.
negative_controls.command: timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 900s env ARTEMIS_TRACES_DIR="$CONTROL_TRACE_ROOT" uv run artemis run "$CONTROL_GOAL" --profile pro --device-serial "$CLAIM_SERIAL" --standalone --session-id "$CONTROL_SESSION_ID" --enable-checker --verification-level final
negative_controls.validator: uv run python -c 'import json,sys; o=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); t=o.get("tests",{}); f=t.get("failed_items",[]); ok=o.get("task_status")=="completed" and t.get("failed")==1 and len(f)==1 and "11/07/2017" in f[0].get("item_text","") and "11/07/2016" in f[0].get("evidence",""); print(json.dumps({"task_status":o.get("task_status"),"failed":t.get("failed"),"failed_items":f})); sys.exit(1 if ok else 2)' "$EVIDENCE_DIR/qualification-control-run_outcome.json"
negative_controls.expected_result: Artemis runner exits 0; preserved run_outcome.json has task_status=completed and exactly one failed assertion whose item names 11/07/2017 and evidence records the observed 11/07/2016; validator exits 1 only for that expected assertion failure and 2 for any other result.
negative_controls.condition: Run only if Sol confirms first-class qualification applies, both fresh reviews and Sol's admission are recorded, QA profiles are revalidated at the serving revision, and provider/account-owner/numeric-spend gates cover the control. Use the exact claim serial and a fresh session ID. Anthropic Android runs remain halted.

evidence_destination: CHE-1143 issue thread and its linked execution report/attachments, supplied by the execution owner
qualification_and_cleanup: Follow the pinned journey and live Android-squad policy. Retain exact commands, host/serial/claim, artifact IDs, positive/rerun/negative-control outcomes, and verified release. Sol verifies release. Uncertain cleanup leaves the target unavailable with a named recovery owner.
